Silver Gold Bull review 2026: is it safe to buy gold online?

Silver Gold Bull is one of Canada's largest online gold dealers — here's what you need to know before you buy.

Is Silver Gold Bull legitimate?

Yes. Silver Gold Bull has operated since 2009 out of Edmonton, Alberta. They are an authorized distributor of the Royal Canadian Mint, a member of the Canadian Numismatic Association, and carry a strong track record with thousands of verified customer reviews on Trustpilot. All shipments are fully insured. They have processed millions of dollars in bullion transactions without significant reported fraud or authentication issues.

Products and pricing

The product catalog covers gold, silver, platinum, and palladium in coins, bars, and rounds. Their strength is Royal Canadian Mint products — if you want Canadian Gold Maple Leafs or RCM bars, Silver Gold Bull is one of the most competitive sources outside of the Mint itself.

Approximate premiums on gold (based on 2026 spot prices around $2,780/oz):

  • 1 oz RCM Gold Bar: ~3–4% over spot
  • 1 oz Canadian Gold Maple Leaf: ~4–5.5% over spot
  • 1 oz American Gold Eagle: ~5–6% over spot (slightly less competitive than US dealers)
  • 1/10 oz Gold Maple Leaf: ~12–16% over spot (small denominations always carry higher premiums regardless of dealer)

Volume pricing is available — buying 10 or more of the same item typically reduces the per-unit premium by 0.5–1%.

Shipping to the US

US buyers order from Silver Gold Bull's Delaware warehouse. This means no cross-border customs processing, no import duties, and delivery times similar to a domestic US dealer — typically 3–6 business days via USPS or UPS with tracking and insurance. Packaging is discreet.

Canadian buyers are served from the Edmonton warehouse, with delivery via Canada Post Xpresspost (typically 3–7 business days depending on province).

Payment methods

Silver Gold Bull accepts bank wire transfer, Interac e-Transfer (Canada only), personal cheque, credit/debit card, and Bitcoin. Wire transfers typically receive the best pricing; card payments carry a small surcharge (usually 2–3%).

Buyback program

They offer a buyback program accessible through their website. Buyback prices are competitive, particularly for RCM products where Canadian domestic demand keeps the spread tight. Expect to receive spot minus 1.5–3.5% depending on the product and current demand conditions.

What Silver Gold Bull does well

The website is clean and well-organised, pricing is transparent, and the checkout process is straightforward. They offer a price-match guarantee for in-stock items at comparable dealers. Customer service responds within 24–48 hours by email, though they do not offer live phone support in all time zones.

What could be better

The product selection, while solid for Canadian products, is smaller than APMEX — rare coins, numismatics, and US Mint collectibles are limited. During periods of high demand (major price moves or political uncertainty), inventory on popular items can sell out quickly. Response times from customer service can stretch to 48 hours during busy periods.

How Silver Gold Bull compares to alternatives

For Canadian buyers purchasing in CAD, Silver Gold Bull is typically one of the two or three most competitive domestic options. For US buyers looking specifically for Canadian Maple Leafs or RCM bars, they are often more competitive than APMEX or Money Metals on those specific products. For US Mint products (American Eagles, American Buffalos), US-based dealers like Money Metals or APMEX will usually offer better pricing.
